summary:
[  edit  ]
The Sort  SOP  allows you to sort points and primitives in different ways. Sometimes the primitives are arranged in the desired order, but the point order is not. There are many possible combinations. To sort vertices, use the  Primitive SOP .

parameters.label: Point Sort
parameters.name: ptsort
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sort the points in the input geometry, according to the following criteria:

parameters.label: No change
parameters.name: none
parameters.description: No sorting is applied.

parameters.label: By vertex order
parameters.name: vtxord
parameters.description: Order points in same order as vertices.

parameters.label: By x
parameters.name: byx
parameters.description: Sort according to X position.

parameters.label: By y
parameters.name: byy
parameters.description: Sort according to Y position.

parameters.label: By z
parameters.name: byz
parameters.description: Sort according to Z position.

parameters.label: Reverse
parameters.name: rev
parameters.description: Reverse the point order.

parameters.label: Random
parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Randomize point order using the specified seed without changing the point positions.

parameters.label: Shift
parameters.name: shift
parameters.description: Shift points by the amount specified on the Offset parameter.

parameters.label: Proximity to  Point
parameters.name: prox
parameters.description: Sort points by their proximity to the specified point.

parameters.label: Along Vector
parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: Sorts points along either a user or object-defined vector.

parameters.label: Distance to  Object
parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Sorts points based on distance to the object specified in the Vector Object parameter.

parameters.label: Closest Neighbour
parameters.name: neighbour
parameters.description: Reorders points based on next closest. Slow nxn search.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.name: pointseed
parameters.description: The random seed when  Point Sort  is set to  Random .

parameters.label: Offset
parameters.name: pointoffset
parameters.description: Shift point order by the amount specified on the offset line.

parameters.label: Point
parameters.name: pointprox
parameters.description: ⊞  - The X, Y and Z coordinates to reference when sorting by  Proximity to  Point  .

parameters.label: Vector  Object
parameters.name: pointobj
parameters.description: Sort points along a vector defined by the object's transformation values.

parameters.label: Vector
parameters.name: pointdir
parameters.description: ⊞  - Allows you to specify a unique vector along which points can be sorted.

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.
